name: DomainTrust Audit — API on RapidAPI
description:
Audit a domain's email trust setup and screen its addresses in one call: DomainTrust Audit checks SPF, DMARC and DKIM configuration and groups the domain's email addresses by validation outcome, so deliverability problems surface before a campaign does.

What you get:
- A mail-authentication audit with a score and per-check findings (SPF, DMARC, DKIM via common selector probing)
- Batch screening of the domain's addresses, grouped by verdict — counts and groups, never invented causes
- A single structured report per domain, built for vendor checks, onboarding reviews and outbound warm-up

Key endpoints:
- POST /audit — audit one domain and screen its addresses
- GET /health — service status

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
